text: Heads-up - the regression checks we imported with last sprint's data-model migration have not all been re-reviewed yet. QA is in release freeze until the cut, so we will go through them after the release.

I'm reverting to the standard greedy implementation for now, but I cannot get a green CI until the acceptance tests are aligned. I'm ready to merge as soon as the tests are fixed.

I'm currently prioritizing the regression test, but I'm blocked from a green CI until @qa-team or @eng-manager can resolve these test mismatches.
